# simple-lock

**Lock type:** Hash preimage lock  
**Source:** https://github.com/OWK50GA/first-ckb-script  
**Status:** ✅ Machine-generated by `ckb-idl-derive`

## Witness layout

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `preimage` | `bytes` | yes | Preimage whose blake2b-256 hash must match the hash in script args |

## How the IDL was generated

1. Added `ckb-idl-derive` as a dependency in `contracts/simple-lock/Cargo.toml`
2. Added an empty `build.rs` at the crate root
3. Defined the witness struct in `src/witness.rs` with `#[derive(CkbWitness)]`
4. Declared `pub mod witness;` in `src/main.rs`
5. Built with `make build CLANG=$(which clang)` from the contract directory
6. IDL written to `target/riscv64imac-unknown-none-elf/release/build/simple-lock-*/out/idl.json`

## Script logic

The lock unlocks a cell if `blake2b_256(preimage) == script.args[0..32]`.
The spender provides the preimage in the witness lock field.
The expected hash is stored in the script args at deploy time.
